item.title: Whiskers 0.8.27
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.26

### Onboarding Experience Refresh

  • Added a cleaner, more guided onboarding layout with clearer step progress and improved visual feedback
  • Improved microphone and Accessibility setup steps with clearer status states and better recovery actions
  • Added a stronger "Try it" verification success state so it is obvious when setup is complete

    • ### Model Setup Clarity

  • Improved onboarding model selection with clearer readiness, download progress, and recommended-model guidance
  • Added explicit loading and setup-required messaging so Bulk Transcription waits for model state instead of showing premature missing-model prompts

    • ### Reliability Improvements

  • Improved transcript loading reliability when macOS temporarily limits secure storage access (for example around wake/lock transitions)
  • Added automatic retry behavior for transient secure-storage failures so history refreshes once the system settles

    • What's New in 0.8.27

    ### Bug Fixes

  • Rounded the macOS app icon assets and added corner-transparency validation so Dock/Finder on macOS 15 renders Whiskers with the expected rounded badge instead of a square splash; if the icon still looks square after updating, to refresh the cache.
